title: Preprocessing witness cannot append output flags to compile_commands entries
body: The baseline -H -E witness failed with GCC's output filename specified twice because the compile_commands command already contains -o <object>; the measurement needed to remove that token before running. Suggested consolidation: provide a supported compile-database trace wrapper that normalizes -c/-o for -E/-ftime reporting and fails with a located diagnostic.

title: Merged SDI cleanup leaves unmanifested heavy headers
body: The standalone generated-header sweep failed on tracked generated/sdi/merged/ExposureTonemap-SDI.g.h, which is no longer listed in shaders/sdi-variants.json and has no source include. The remedy was to remove the stale artifact manually. Suggested consolidation: merge-variants should enumerate and delete or drift-fail unreferenced merged outputs, including validation companions.
